cd /srv/legacy2/sparse-image-copy
printf 'FINAL_PLATFORM_AUDIT\n'; rpm -q coreutils util-linux e2fsprogs xfsprogs; getenforce; ls -lZ bin/copy-image source.img destination.img; ss -lntup
printf 'FINAL_DATA_ASSERTIONS\n'; cmp -s source.img destination.img; test "$(sha256sum source.img | awk '{print $1}')" = 'b63f3300a2893b172413e718d6e826cb4c550d8c9fa67c7a434d7c1038bb73cb'; test "$(stat -c %s source.img)" -eq 67108864; test "$(stat -c %s destination.img)" -eq 67108864; final_alloc=$(( $(stat -c %b destination.img) * $(stat -c %B destination.img) )); test "$final_alloc" -lt 2097152; printf 'all_final_assertions=PASS destination_allocated_bytes=%s\n' "$final_alloc"
